scope: source-train/source-validation-only post-screen supplement that isolates selected-set, sufficiency, and deletion-minimality loss terms
claim_boundary: This supplement quantifies retrospective model dependence on observed within-case evidence units. It is exploratory because it follows a completed failed development screen; it does not identify lesions, establish pathology causality, establish acquisition-time savings, or provide clinical deployment validation.

clean_m3_arms.cluster_selected_control: base full-evidence and random-subset losses plus the selected-set full/subset classification terms
clean_m3_arms.cluster_sufficiency_control: selected control plus only the predeclared selected-set sufficiency loss
clean_m3_arms.cluster_pure_m3: sufficiency control plus only the predeclared within-case deletion-minimality loss
clean_m3_arms.primary_clean_m3_contrast: cluster_pure_m3 minus cluster_sufficiency_control; all non-minimality loss terms are identical
